title: Trigger Callouts: Async Choices for a Credit Check That Must Retry

steps.prompt: An Account trigger fires when Status__c changes to Pending Credit Check. It must call an external credit REST API and write the result back to the Account. The API sometimes times out, and a timed-out check must retry automatically. How should the architect run the callout?

options.label: Enqueue a Queueable callout job that chains a retry on timeout
options.rationale: Callouts from a trigger or after DML must run in a future or Queueable method so the trigger does not hold the database connection open. A Queueable job can enqueue a follow-up job from its execute method, which gives a timed-out check a path to retry.

options.label: Pass the Account Ids to an @future(callout=true) method called from the trigger
options.rationale: A future method cannot call another future method and returns no job Id to monitor, so a timed-out check has no built-in way to retry.

options.label: Make the callout in the before-update trigger, before any DML statement runs
options.rationale: Apex does not allow a synchronous callout from a trigger, even before DML, because it would hold the database connection open for the length of the callout.
